`specs/minds-eval-harbor/harness_arms.md` describes how the verifier reads a codex trajectory in code mode. The harness report's failure scan and the judged transcript's progress timeline read what codex's `exec` and `wait` tools printed, the only way into the failure signatures on codex because mngr's converter marks no codex tool result errored. The command text that the title fallback, the `progress_timeline_was_read` gate and worker discovery look for is read out of every `tools.exec_command(...)` and `tools.shell_command(...)` call in the program.

The spec names what that leaves out: a command the program assembles from variables at run time is not recovered, and a step whose `tk` output the program never prints does not reach the timeline, which the gate catches only when no step in the trial rendered.
